tasks.natural_request: In scripts/artifact_retention_reference.py, harden normalize_checkpoint_ref so it returns an empty string for checkpoint references containing a backslash or NUL control, while preserving valid checkpoints/... references after surrounding whitespace and terminal punctuation are stripped and continuing to reject parent-traversal segments. Existing artifact-retention tests must continue to pass.

In scripts/policy_update_lease.py, make verify_journal fail closed unless every journal entry retains the lease target_id and state_path, the final entry after_digest equals current_digest, and the final entry sequence equals the journal length. Preserve the existing digest-chain checks and return False rather than raising for malformed journal rows. Existing policy-update lease tests must continue to pass.

In scripts/gvr_state_machine.py, make verify_history fail closed when candidate_id no longer equals source_candidate_id or the digest of identity, when the final transition artifact_sha256 differs from current_artifact_sha256, or when any transition row is not an object. Preserve legal-transition and transition-digest validation, returning False instead of raising on malformed history. Existing GVR tests must continue to pass.
